title: Woodbrook Court, Castleknock, Dublin 15
description:

RAY COOKE Lettings take great pleasure in introducing this fantastic 2 bed / 2 bath duplex apartment to the letting market in Woodbrook Hall, Castleknock, Dublin 15.
Castleknock is one of Dublin 15's most sought-after locations and offers a fantastic range of amenities right on your doorstep. The area boasts excellent transport links, local shops, schools, restaurants and leisure facilities, while Dublin City Centre and the M50 are easily accessible.
The accommodation is exceptionally spacious and light-filled throughout and comprises of a welcoming entrance hallway, large open-plan living/dining area with fully fitted kitchen, two very generous double bedrooms and two bathrooms, with the master bedroom benefiting from its own ensuite. Both bedrooms also benefit from walk-in wardrobes, providing excellent storage space.
The apartment is presented in excellent condition throughout and offers generous living accommodation, quality fixtures and fittings and plenty of storage.
This superb apartment would make an ideal home for a wide range of tenants and viewing is highly advised. Contact Ray Cooke Lettings today to arrange a viewing.
